senses.gloss: m. (cmp. גחל, v. Lane Customs, 1837, p. 51 sq.) ko ḥl, a powder used for painting the eye-lids, stibium.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:3">Sabb. VIII, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 78b:2">78ᵇ</cite>) <cite ref="K00451"><he>כּוֹ׳</he></cite> Ar. (ed. <he>כְּח׳</he>); Y. ib. 11ᵇ bot. <he>כו׳</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 88b:9">Ḥull. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>השחור והכ׳</he> powdered coal and stibium.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a">Snh. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 17a:2">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> (in a song) <he>לא כֹּחָל</he> here is no paint (no showiness). [<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:4">Tosef. Nidd. VI, 4</cite> <cite ref="K00238"><he>כוחל</he></cite>, read: <cite ref="B00225"><he>בּוֹחַל</he></cite>.]
